card.name: Maintain pressure or position instructions
card.fires_on: The verb maintain (or the words right after it, like 'this' or 'be') in instructions to hold a pressure, position or steady force. It also fires weakly on 'persistent' before effects or erections.

modes.label: Hold pressure or position
modes.description: 'Maintain' in device or ear-drop steps telling the user to keep a pressure or posture.
modes.example: After injection,<< maintain>> pressure on the plunger head and remove

modes.label: Words after maintain
modes.description: Words that follow or continue the hold instruction, such as 'this' or 'be' before 'maintained'.
modes.example: Maintain<< this>> position for 1 minute after the drug

modes.label: Persistent effects
modes.description: The word persistent before a lasting effect or condition.
modes.example: has been used to terminate<< persistent>> pharmacodynamic effects.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about holding or sustained actions, such as grip, stretch and stare.
card.plain: It marks instructions to keep holding a pressure or position, and sometimes the word persistent.
